text: Bessent Remarks on Iran  On August 13, 2026, Bessent said in an interview on Newsmax’s “Rob Schmitt Tonight” that the U.S. will apply measures on Iran “like have never been seen in the history of economic isolation on a country.” He added: “Watch this space for more announcements coming next week.”  He specifically described it as “a combination of economic isolation like the world has never seen before, and the continued blockade in the Strait of Hormuz that will keep anything from going in or out of the Iranian ports.”  This fits into the broader Trump administration strategy of heavy economic pressure on Iran (often referred to in earlier comments as “Operation Economic Fury” or similar efforts), layered on top of existing sanctions, secondary sanctions threats, and the naval/port blockade related to the Strait of Hormuz. The comments come amid ongoing tensions involving Iran, energy flows through the Strait, and efforts to increase pressure without (or alongside) further military escalation.  Major outlets including Reuters, U.S. News, Times of Israel, Arab News, and others reported the statements on the same day. Further details on the specific new measures are expected next week, per Bessent.
